summary: Direct extraction and inspection of the rebuilt NSIS installer, confirming the AVX2/FMA/F16C SIMD fix is genuinely compiled into the shipped binary and every prior phase's feature/DLL fix still holds.

installerChecksum.sizeChangeNote: Slightly larger (+9180 bytes) - expected: AVX2-specific ggml kernel code paths are now compiled in (previously entirely absent, SSE4.2-only), plus the small Bible-search filter frontend addition.

runtimeDllsStillPresent.note: Byte sizes identical to prior phases - same source DLLs, same toolchain, unaffected by this phase's SIMD/build-tooling fix.

cipDesktopExeVerification.fileCommand: PE32+ executable (GUI) x86-64 (stripped to external PDB), for MS Windows, 11 sections

simdFixDirectEvidence.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-nm and x86_64-w64-mingw32-objdump against the exe extracted from THIS built installer, not an intermediate build artifact.
simdFixDirectEvidence.symbolResolution: ggml_cpu_has_avx2, ggml_cpu_has_fma, ggml_cpu_has_f16c all resolve as defined text symbols (nm shows 'T', not the undefined-reference link failure seen before the fix).
simdFixDirectEvidence.disassemblyEvidence: objdump -d finds genuine AVX/AVX2 YMM-register instructions, e.g. 'vpbroadcastb %xmm0,%ymm0', 'vmovdqa %ymm0,(%rax)', 'vmovups %ymm0,...' - proof the SIMD code paths are actually compiled in, not merely that the CMake cache variable was set without effect.

cipDesktopExeVerification.whisperFeatureSymbolProof: x86_64-w64-mingw32-nm finds 93 matches for whisper_full_with_state (unchanged from prior phases - the whisper feature itself is unaffected, only its compiled code-generation target changed).
cipDesktopExeVerification.dialogPluginSymbolProof: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings/nm find 144/165 matches for tauri_plugin_dialog respectively - Phase 3.8.7.1's model-picker feature unaffected.
cipDesktopExeVerification.bibleSearchFilterNote: The new book-name prefix filter (filterBooksByPrefix) is pure frontend TypeScript, bundled into the Vite build's JS asset - not separately verifiable via native-binary symbol inspection; covered instead by the frontend test suite (218/218 passed, including 6 new tests for this helper).

automatedVerification: scripts/build-windows-whisper.sh's own final step (7z-extraction DLL-presence check) passed on this build - 'confirmed: libstdc++-6.dll, libgcc_s_seh-1.dll, libwinpthread-1.dll are all present in the installer'.
